provider.name: Krutrim Cloud
provider.summary: Indian AI cloud of Ola Krutrim. Its compute documentation prices GPU virtual machines by the hour in Indian rupees, each a whole VM with its vCPUs and memory; the figure is the on-demand rate. The page also lists one- and six-month reserved rates, which are not shown here, and says nothing about GST. The dollar figure uses the ECB reference rate of the day.
provider.notes: GitBook ARIA table "GPU Flavor | GPU Type / Count | RAM | GPU Memory | vCPUs | Unit | On-Demand Price | Monthly Reserved | 6 Month Reserved"; on-demand column only (1- and 6-month terms are no market of ours); AI Pods table not read; whole VM -> instance; cheapest per GPU, smaller flavour on a tie; A100 80GB -> a100-80, H100 (NVLink, 80 GB) -> h100; INR via ECB, the page says nothing about GST; region null
